page.layout: One column of running text, with run-in italic headings in the text block. Running head top right, page number top left. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword.

p.i: Duo enumerat, uastitatem uidelicet & contritionem, eaq; per interpretationem exponit, quando adijcit de fame & gladio, ex quibus duobus & cætera omnis generis mala intelligi conuenit.

main_text.p: Et quis consolabitur te?)Amplificatio malo-rum, ab eo quòd in tantis periculis uel in tanta clade nullam adhuc senserunt consolationem, quando illi ipsi qui consolari debuissent, etiam cum cæteris prostrati sunt. An & hoc de Ecclesia accipi queat, aliorum esto iudicium.

Idcirco audi quæso.)Exhortatio habens promissionem de auferendis malis, si resipiscant. Iubet autem attentos esse, simulq; propriæ indignitatis consideratione cupit moueri. Pauperculam appellat synagogam, ob peccata atq; inopiam sanæ doctrinæ: imebriatâ uero, propter exhaustum à se calicem furoris Domini. Dominator, & Deus, & Dominus illorum est: quia illi, licet Euangelium reijcietes, dilecti tamen adhuc sunt Deo propter patres, iuxta illud ad Roman.ii: Secundum Euangelium quidem imimici propter uos, secundum electionem autem dilecti propter patres.
Ecce tuli de manu.) Promissio: Auferentur à uobis omnia pericula.

page.notes: Long s was normalised to s throughout. The printed hyphen is kept on "malo-rum" and "crudelita-tem"; "hostes" and "generis" break at line ends without a visible hyphen and are written whole. "imebriatâ" and "imimici" are copied as printed. "Roman.ii" is read as lowercase numerals with some doubt. The run-in headings (Amplificatio, Exhortatio, Promissio) stand inside the text block, so they are not notes. The stray mark at the right edge beside "imebriatâ" is not text.
